# gitmoap_repository_catalog_environments (Data Source)

List a repository's environments. Returns the environments the repository declares, alphabetically by slug, leaving out archived ones unless `include_archived=true`. With `inherited=true` the ancestor groups' environments are included too, a nearer slug shadowing a farther one: the set a pipeline in this repository can deploy to, minus any owned by a group you cannot see. Filter by `tier` or `search`; pages hold up to 100 environments (20 by default). Reporters and above may call it: environments are not public, even on a public repository.

The token needs `catalog:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

data "gitmoap_repository_catalog_environments" "api" {
  repo_id = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) The owning repository's id

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) Include archived environments (excluded by default)
- `inherited` (Boolean) Also return the ancestor-group environments this repository may reference — what a pipeline author needs, since a node's `environment:` resolves up the chain
- `search` (String) Match the slug or display name
- `tier` (String) Filter by tier

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `archived` (Boolean)
- `display_name` (String)
- `environment_id` (String)
- `scope` (Attributes) A group or a repository, whichever a setting belongs to.

Set one of `group` or `repo`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--scope))
- `slug` (String)
- `tier` (String) What kind of environment this is, whatever it is called: `development`, `testing`, `staging`
or `production`. A `production` environment is protected by default.
- `url` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--items--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.scope`

Read-Only:

- `group` (String)
- `repo` (String)
